incident-bot: :warning: SEV2 — Repeated smart-routing health-check churn detected across regions (us-east ↔ us-west ↔ eu). Spike in 5xx and tail latency from 15:23 UTC. Auto-failover observed ~25x in 12m.

mike (oncall-ml): I'm the ML on-call. Looking at request traces and model variant churn. Starting log grep.

jamie (sre): I see the routing state machine toggling regions every ~35s. Health probes for the same pool flip between PASS/FAIL. Likely a probe hysteresis edge-case.

reena (eng-runtime): Pushed a small hysteresis tweak 03:10 this morning (reduce decay window from 90s -> 30s). That might explain sensitivity. Also noticed routing policy "fallback_promote=true" which promotes larger variant in fallback regions.

alex (infra): Probe outputs (excerpt):
```
2024-05-06T15:23:07Z us-east probe -> PASS (rtt 120ms)
2024-05-06T15:23:42Z us-west probe -> FAIL (connect timeout 2s)
2024-05-06T15:24:17Z eu probe -> mark us-west unhealthy
2024-05-06T15:24:52Z us-east probe -> mark eu unhealthy
```

tara (support): Two customers reported increased latency and sporadic 5xx errors. Customer X saw ~40% slower p50 on chat endpoints. Customer Y reported some calls returning 502.

mike (oncall-ml): Important: when fallback occurs, routing selects variant v-large in fallback region due to cost/perf profile. That variant has slower cold-starts and higher memory usage -> timeouts if provisioned capacity is low. We might be thrashing between region+variant combos.

jamie (sre): Immediate mitigations we can try: (1) revert hysteresis change, (2) disable fallback_promote, (3) raise probe timeout and require 2 consecutive fails. Which should we do first?

reena (eng-runtime): I'll flip fallback_promote=false for routing policy in canary (us-east-1a) and watch. Command: 
```
redwoodctl routing update --policy global-smart --set fallback_promote=false --target us-east-1a --dry-run
redwoodctl routing update --policy global-smart --set fallback_promote=false --target us-east-1a --apply
```

alex (infra): I'll bump probe timeout 2s->6s and require 2 consecutive failures before marking unhealthy. Patching probe-config now.

incident-bot: Noted. Escalation: paging oncall-sre and platform leads.

mike (oncall-ml): Canary applied. Early signal: canary traffic shows much lower variant flips and latency stabilizing within 30s. No 5xx in canary group. Rolling to rest of regions in 3m.

reena (eng-runtime): Global apply done. Also reverting hysteresis tweak to previous 90s.

jamie (sre): After changes: failover incidents dropped from 25x to 2x in 10m window. Some residual errors as connections drain. Marking incident as mitigated but leaving monitoring open.

tara (support): Customer X and Y notified of mitigation. I'll send a short status update and offer a postmortem link once ready.

dylan (product): Root-cause hypothesis? Need clear actionables for postmortem: config review, routing-policy defaults, customer impact summary, SLA exposure.

mike (oncall-ml): Hypothesis: the hysteresis reduction made probes too sensitive; minor network jitter caused rapid HEALTH state flips. Smart-routing's fallback_promote behavior then escalated to larger model variants in fallback regions. The combination produced cross-region/variant thrash and overloaded fallback nodes -> 5xx/timeouts.

jamie (sre): Action items (short-term):
- jamie (sre): keep monitoring for 30m, then clear if stable.
- reena (eng-runtime): add guard to routing decision: do not promote to higher-req variant unless fallback_capacity >= 2x baseline. (PR assigned).
- alex (infra): revert probe change docs and add automated canary for probe hysteresis values.
- mike (oncall-ml): create postmortem doc with timeline, traces, config diffs, customer impact.
- tara (support): post customer follow-ups and collect logs for affected tenants.

reena (eng-runtime): I'm opening PR to add feature-flag: promote_on_fail -> kFallbackFavorLocal which prefers same-variant fallback if capacity marginal. Will include unit tests and a simulate_jitter scenario.

incident-bot: Incident timeline: 15:23 detect -> 15:27 canary mitigation (disable promotion) -> 15:32 probe tuning -> 15:35 global rollout -> 15:47 stabilization observed.

mike (oncall-ml): I'll draft the postmortem and tag reena/jamie for review. Please include the config diff for 03:10 hysteresis change (reena, can you attach?).

reena (eng-runtime): Attaching config diff to postmortem doc. Quick note: we reduced decay window to try to speed failover for hot shards; unintended side-effect on cross-region noise. Adding test coverage to prevent regression.

tara (support): Sent interim message to customers with impact summary and mitigation. They requested ETA for root cause analysis; I'll link to postmortem when available.

jamie (sre): Follow-up proposals for postmortem: add canary gating for routing policy changes, increase default probe decay window to 60s, and require a promote_cooldown for variant promotions (e.g., no more than 1 promote per 5m per pool).

reena (eng-runtime): Agreed on gating. Also adding a simulation harness that replays probe noise at scale. PR #3511.

incident-bot: Status: mitigated, monitoring. Incident remains open for postmortem completion. :white_check_mark:
